root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly assigned separate reset and clock enable bits (rst_mask and clk_mask) for the VPU G1 and G2 sub-domains on i.MX8MQ, but the hardware's ADB in the VPUMIX domain lacks per-subunit reset/clock control and is gated/reset together with the VPUs, so attempting to reset G1 or G2 individually causes a system hang.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "the ADB in the VPUMIX domain has no separate reset and clock enable bits, but is ungated and reset together with the VPUs. So we can't reset G1 or G2 separately, it may led to the system hang." The patch removes `rst_mask` and `clk_mask` from `imx8mq_vpu_blk_ctl_domain_data[IMX8MQ_VPUBLK_PD_G1]` and `[IMX8MQ_VPUBLK_PD_G2]`, and adds a comment explaining the hardware limitation.
